subject: Supplier Kickstart — two-way readiness matrix & PO mapping
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lynxlogix.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
Cc: vendor@lynxlogix.com
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier kickstart: onboarding items and next steps

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for making time to kick off vendor setup for Lynx Logix. Per our brief call this morning, attached is our vendor intake sheet (lynx_vendor_info_sheet.xlsx) and a short list of the items we typically need to complete your onboarding:

- Completed vendor setup form (PDF) with tax info and primary billing contact
- Certificate of insurance (COI)
- W-9 (for US entities) or W-8 if applicable
- Banking info for ACH (voided check or bank letter)
- Any required security/compliance docs (SOC 2 Type II report if available)
- PO/Invoice contact and preferred invoice routing (email + any accounting system e.g., Coupa)

We also want to confirm PO terms: do you require a specific PO number format, and are net-30 terms standard? If there are any vendor registration portals (Ariba/Oracle), please send the links.

I attached our intake sheet for your convenience. Can you confirm preferred next steps and an estimated timeline to deliver the items above?

Cheers,
Elena
Vendor Ops
Lynx Logix
[attachment: lynx_vendor_info_sheet.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lynxlogix.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.example.com, marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier kickstart: onboarding items and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the sheet. Looping in Monica (procurement ops) and Marcus (finance) to confirm our side and share Redwood's intake artifacts.

Quick answers up front:
- PO format: REDW-<4 digit year>-<6 digit seq> (we'll include an example PO)
- Standard terms: Net 45 for first 90 days for new partners, then Net 30 once verified
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwood.example.com (PDF preferred).

What we need from Lynx Logix (what you listed plus a couple Redwood-specific items):
1) Completed Redwood vendor setup form (attached).
2) Legal entity name + DUNS/LEI if available.
3) Contact for technical escalation (name/email/phone).
4) If you plan to collect telemetry from our systems, please provide the data handling policy.

What Redwood will provide to you:
- A completed vendor record and sample PO template (PDF).
- Visibility on anticipated first PO and expected payment window once the first invoice is processed.
- A short onboarding coordinator call (15-20m) to confirm routing and any SOC/KYC questions.

Can you get the completed form back to us by EOD Tue 8 May? If that's tight, propose a date and we'll adjust.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_form.pdf; sample_po_format.pdf

Thanks — Stephanie
Steph Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_vendor_setup_form.pdf (PDF)]

Forwarding initial thread — attaching our usual checklist and notes for Marcus on finance verification.

Marcus — can you confirm what documentation Finance needs to release vendor payments (bank letter vs voided check, PO match tolerances)? Also flag any anti-fraud checks we should run.

- COI meets minimum coverage (see policy link below)

- PO and invoice terms logged in ERP (Net 45 during probation)
- Tax & compliance approvals obtained if non-US entity

Date: Tue, 07 May 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier kickstart: onboarding items and next steps

Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of final items to keep this moving:

1) Please sign the attached vendor setup PDF and submit a W-9 (or W-8-BEN) and COI. We prefer ACH with micro-deposit verification; include a bank letter if you can.
2) We need the primary billing contact and PO acknowledgement contact (name/email) — copy both on the first invoice.
3) If Lynx requires a vendor agreement, send your standard agreement now; otherwise we'll proceed with our procurement terms and provide a DocuSign for the vendor setup form.

Next steps on our side: I'll validate bank details and confirm payment terms after the first invoice posts. Monica will follow up on certificates. Stephanie will finalize PO mapping.

DocuSign link for Redwood vendor form (expiring in 7 days): https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC1234

Attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_form_filled_example.pdf (example filled for reference), sample_po_format.pdf

Best,
